label: Test coverage of all contingent recipients at the necessary intermediary
meaning: Both d and g exist in every accessible world. At false, g gives being to the contingent c, the only possible actual contingent recipient there. The incoming edge d to g leaves g derived. If the selected g reached every actual concretum, a finite path to the actual root d would identify g with d, contrary to the distinct constructors. The use of the naming predicate stipulates a candidate, without independently warranting its divine status.
